Use case: ads-marketing / product-mockup. Redesign the supplied PromptPack Money Audit Pack cover into a premium ecommerce cover image with MONEY SAVING as the unmistakable main hook. Output one finished landscape 3:2 image, 1536x1024. The supplied existing cover is the edit target and brand/layout reference. Preserve its elegant warm cream #FFFBF2 faint dot-grid studio, mint #A8F0C6, pink #F598F2, yellow #FFE14D platform, bold black condensed editorial typography, tactile matte paper and beautiful hard shadows. Improve the hierarchy dramatically.
The main readable headline, much larger than any other text in the whole image, is exactly: 'FIND WAYS TO' followed by 'SAVE MONEY.' Make SAVE MONEY. huge bold black lettering on a yellow or mint field. Place this headline across the right upper half of the composition, occupying about 45% image width and 35% height; it must be the first thing noticed at a 400px storefront card size. No other large competing marketing headline.
On the left, a mint upright digital-guide mockup at a subtle three-quarter angle, around 38% of image width. Its exact cover text: small PROMPTPACK, main MONEY / AUDIT / PACK, lower REVIEW YOUR RECURRING BILLS, footer DIGITAL GUIDE + PROMPTS. The book's product title should be visibly secondary to SAVE MONEY.
On the lower right, below the large benefit headline: a beautiful sculptural magnifying glass over a generic receipt and one small tidy stack of metallic coins, with a short pink review card reading REVIEW YOUR BILLS. No dollar amounts, transaction data, invented customers or screenshots. A small mint/cream checklist card can show three simple lines: KEEP, COMPARE, NEGOTIATE. These are conceptual props for reviewing recurring costs, not live software controls.
Polished, intentional visual hierarchy, generous breathing space, all corners safely inside frame, 6% safe margins. The user should immediately understand this is a money-saving opportunity toolkit, not only a book called Money Audit. Do not invent a guaranteed saving, percentages, dollar figures, refund, automatic cancellation, banking integration, profit, investment returns or savings results. No prices, ratings, testimonials, third-party logos, physical shipping claims or extra copy. Use the supplied exact spellings. Keep the aesthetic consistent with the other premium PromptPack cream/yellow/mint covers.
assets.notes: Benefit-first generated digital-guide mockup: FIND WAYS TO SAVE MONEY. Shows recurring-bill review, a receipt/magnifier, a coin stack and Keep/Compare/Negotiate decisions. No fixed savings, automatic actions or guaranteed outcomes.
